report.summary: Found 0 high, 4 medium, and 220 low technical issues across 172 crawled pages. Search Console and Google Analytics are not connected; provider-backed sections were skipped.

coverage.detail: Every finding in the declared report scope is represented.

completion.instruction: Before finishing, return one allowed outcome and reason for every open item; the outcome count must equal counts.returned. A review is a decision task, not an instruction to change the site. Do not silently drop findings.

verification.instruction: After edits, run each changed item's verification and rerun the originating report. A code change alone does not close a finding.
verification.reportCheck: Rerun seo report with the same inputs and confirm the finding is absent or its evidence now matches the intended state.

items.title: structured_data_missing: No structured data detected (18 URLs)

evidence.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This is a review observation. Confirm it before scheduling implementation work.

verification.expected: Re-run the crawl and confirm structuredDataFormats lists the added format, then validate the page with a structured data tester.

review.question: Does a specific structured data type accurately describe the visible content on this page?
review.changeOnlyIf: Add markup only when a specific schema type fits the page and every claimed property is supported by its visible content.
review.ifConfirmed: Observed state that needs intent confirmation before treating it as a defect. Add structured data only where a schema type genuinely describes the page, for example an article page describing its article. Validate the markup after adding it, and leave pages without a fitting schema type unmarked.
review.ifNotNeeded: Leave the page unmarked and record that no suitable schema type was confirmed.
doNot: Do not add Organization or another generic schema type only to clear this finding.
Do not copy site-wide markup onto unrelated page types.
